Name: Montag's Modern Kitchen and Farmhouse
Author: Piliferous
Description:
[size=3]Thank you for downloading Montag's Modern Kitchen and Farmhouse!  [b][color=#ff0000]Updated for 1.5 finally![/color][/b]  Added spouse room divider (cellar recolor disabled to increase compatibility with other full recolors).
[/size][size=3]
[color=#ff00ff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4382]COMPANION TO MONTAG'S MODERN WALLPAPERS AND HARDWOODS[/url]﻿[/color][/size]
I thought the default kitchen looked a little messy, so I decided to create a clean and modern redesign of the farmhouse.  There are 4 options for kitchen countertop color, 4 options for backsplash color, and 4 options for farmhouse interior recolor.  This means there are 64 permutations of color combinations!

See the above pictures for "staged farmhouse" photographs.

[b][color=#a4c2f4]TO EDIT YOUR COLOR OPTIONS:[/color][/b]
1. Install the mod and launch the game (this creates a "config.json" file in the mod folder)
2. Quit the game
3. Open the newly created "config.json" file in the “\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Montag's Modern Kitchen and Farmhouse” folder
4. Change the options to your preferred colors!

[b][color=#b6d7a8]COLOR OPTIONS:[/color][/b]
InteriorColor: None, Brown, White, Grey
CounterColor: Green, Beige, Black, Blue
BacksplashColor: White, Grey, WhiteGrey, Blue

This mod is a Content Patcher pack, so please be sure you have Content Patcher downloaded.  

__________________________________________________________________

[u]To Install:
[/u]1. Ensure Content Patcher and SMAPI are up to date
2. Download and unzip the mod file
3. Place the entire folder within the ﻿ ﻿“\Stardew Valley\Mods” folder

[u]Requirements:[/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

﻿__________________________________________________________________
If anyone is curious, the furniture mod in the staged photograph is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1731]Mi's and Magimatica Country Furniture[/url]﻿.  Feel free to send any suggestions or issues to me via message!
